title: Foreign Workers (Prohibition of Unlawful Employment and Assurance of Fair Conditions) Law, 5751-1991
amended: amended several times (consolidated English text undated)
source_tier: Secondary (UNHCR Refworld; unofficial English translation of a consolidated version)
site_status: NEW: add to national-laws (already cited in the domestic-workers database as Foreign Workers Law, 1991)
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the Refworld PDF supplied by IMR (unofficial English, consolidated with later amendments, date of consolidation not stated). Known as the Foreign Workers Law. In force 1 May 1991. Employer may employ a foreign worker only with a medical certificate, a written contract in a language the worker understands (s. 1C), medical insurance (s. 1D) and suitable housing (s. 1E); deposits into a Foreign Workers Fund paid to the worker on departure (Chapter Four, s. 1K), with exemptions or reductions possible for nursing-care (caregiver) workers employed by individuals; offences and supervision in Chapter Five. Same PDF also on ecoi.net (ACCORD): https://www.ecoi.net/en/file/local/1070205/1226_1279194761_4c36ed992.pdf. Official Hebrew text to find on Nevo or the Knesset legislation database.

title: Employment of Employees by Manpower Contractors (Application for Licence) Regulations, 5756-1996
title_original: תקנות העסקת עובדים על ידי קבלני כוח אדם (בקשה לרשיון), תשנ"ו-1996
source_tier: Secondary (israelilegislation.com, private site; unofficial English translation of the consolidated Hebrew text as of 2023-09-18)
note: Read on 2026-11-21 in the built-in browser. Only the Hebrew text in Reshumot is binding; official Hebrew text still to find (Nevo or the Knesset database). Made under ss. 2(d) and 25 of the Employment of Employees by Manpower Contractors Law, 5756-1996 (the parent Law is not yet in our tables). Licence applications to the Minister of Labour with an affidavit, office conditions (incl. a private interview room for job candidates) and the data needed to set the guarantee amount; consent to criminal-record checks of managers; decision within three months (reg. 4). The Foreign Workers Law, 5751-1991 adopts this Law's definition of 'manpower contractor'.

title: Prevention of Infiltration Law (Offenses and Jurisdiction), 5714-1954
amended: Amendment No. 3 and Temporary Order 5772-2012; Legislative Amendments and Temporary Order 2014 (and later amendments to Aug 2018)
source_tier: Secondary (unofficial English translation, consolidated version as of August 2018; translator not stated)
site_status: NEW: add to national-laws; official link still needed
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the unofficial consolidated English translation (Aug 2018) supplied by IMR; source website not known, so no link yet. Official Hebrew text to find on Nevo or the Knesset database. Defines an 'infiltrator' as a non-resident who entered other than through a designated border crossing (s. 1); offences ss. 2-9; presumption that anyone who entered without permission or stays unlawfully is an infiltrator (s. 10); deportation orders by the Minister of Defense (s. 30); custody, review by the Director of Border Control and release on guarantee (ss. 30A-30D); detention conditions (s. 30B); residence orders and Residency Centers (ss. 32A-32D, the 'Holot' facility). The Supreme Court struck down earlier detention provisions in Adam v. Knesset (2013), already in our decisions table (il-adam-2013).

title: Code of Labour (Law of 23 September 1946)
amended: amended many times, incl. Decree 8496/1974, Law 5/87 (1987), Law 207/2000
source_tier: Secondary (L'Argus de la Législation Libanaise, private translation, Vol. 56 No. 1, Q1 2010; all rights reserved, not linked)
site_status: NEW: add to national-laws; official Arabic link still needed
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the Argus English translation supplied by IMR (text as at early 2010). Art. 7 excludes domestic servants employed in private houses and agricultural enterprises not connected with trade or industry (the latter left to a special law). Art. 12: written contract in Arabic, may be translated for a foreign worker. Art. 59: foreign workers get Lebanese workers' rights on dismissal only on condition of reciprocity and must hold a work permit. Later change to check: Law 129 of 2010 is understood to have exempted Palestinian refugees from the reciprocity condition in art. 59 (not in this 2010 translation; not yet verified). Official Arabic text to find (e.g. Lebanese University legal database or Official Gazette).
